1.a: Yes. All OIYO personality and psychology tests and tools are free — there is no payment or subscription.

2.a: Each test is built on published psychological scales and academic models (MBTI, Big Five, RIASEC, etc.). They are a tool for self-understanding and do not replace medical or professional diagnosis.

3.q: How long does one test take?
3.a: Most take 2–5 minutes. It may be slightly longer depending on the number of questions.

4.q: Are my answers and personal data safe?
4.a: Results are stored mainly in your browser (locally). We do not ask for sensitive personal data or sell it to anyone.

5.q: Can I save or share my results?
5.a: Yes. You can save your result as an image or share a link, and combine multiple test results in the Ontology view.

q1.question: Is OIYO free?
q1.answer: yes OIYO offers a free personality test and basic features. If you want deeper insights, you can use premium features.

q2.question: What payment methods can I use?
q2.answer: We support all major credit cards, PayPal, and various local payment methods depending on your region.

q3.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
q3.answer: Of course! You can cancel your subscription at any time in your account settings. It is processed right away without any further questions.

q4.question: Is a refund possible?
q4.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you are not satisfied with the premium features.
